defects.description: The glossary term 'Subject' is translated as 'Субъекты' instead of the required 'Объект обсуждения'.
The field name 'severity' is translated in the descriptive text, which should remain as a code identifier.
Field names in the 'EscalationRecord' table (identifiers) have been translated into Russian, which is prohibited for technical identifiers.
The field reference 'escalation_reason' is translated as 'причина_эскалации'.
Code tokens/object properties within the 'positions' rule are translated instead of remaining byte-identical to the source.
